subject: The one thing 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: I discovered a secret most couples miss. It's the easiest way to keep the spark from fading.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I first built SoulPlan, I thought the AI date ideas would be the star. But I was wrong. There's a tiny feature buried in the app that, honestly, most people scroll right past. And the couples who do use it? They're the ones texting me 'This saved our Friday nights.'

Here's the truth: the routine trap doesn't just kill date nights. It quietly makes your partner feel like an afterthought. You don't run out of ideas overnight. It's a slow fade. But the couples who avoid this? They have a simple hack. They capture little moments of 'we should do that someday' before they evaporate.

That's the Date Wishlist. It's not just a list. It's your secret weapon against 'I don't know, what do you want to do?' You and your partner can drop in anything—a restaurant you drove past, a weird festival you heard about, a dream weekend. The app saves it all in one place. Then, when you're planning, you're not starting from a blank page. You're picking from your own shared dreams.

Open the app right now. Tap 'Wishlist' and add just one thing you've talked about. Do it before you forget. It takes 20 seconds. I'll wait. P.S. The couples who use the Wishlist plan 3x more dates. They're also the ones who never say 'We never do anything anymore.'
